properties.areaDesc: Coconino, AZ; Navajo, AZ
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 3 at 6:02AM MST until November 3 at 10:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...The Little Colorado River from Winslow to Leupp...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM MST.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Little Colorado River is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 558 AM MST, water levels near Woodruff and Holbrook have
fallen below flood stage with no additional rises expected. Water
levels at Winslow remain above moderate flood stage, and
additional rises to above major flood stage will be possible
through the day today. Flooding will continue to remain a threat
downstream of Winslow in the Birdsprings area as well. Flooding
is already ongoing.
- For Little Colorado at Winslow:
At 5:00am MST the stage was 23.18 feet.
Flood Stage is 19.0 feet.
Forecast: Additional rises over 25.0 feet are possible through
the day.
Impacts:
At 22.0 feet: Lowland flooding on right bank. Damage on left bank
to Ames Acres and Bushman Acres in the event of levee failure.
At 25.0 feet: Levee is overtopped. Major flooding of portions of
Winslow including Ames Acres and Bushman Acres.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Winslow, Leupp, Birdsprings, Sunrise, Bushman Acres, Homolovi
Ruins State Park and Clear Creek Reservoir.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
properties.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

caused by recent runoff from upstream rain and snowmelt, is
occurring.

South Central Alamosa County in southeastern Colorado...

roads remain closed due to flooding. Expect many areas of slow
moving or standing water through eastern Conejos County.

causing flooding into eastern Conejos County.

Ortiz.

Weather Service when you can do so safely.
